property_summary: For any fuzzed amount, a direct ether transfer to C (the receive path) must succeed and increment depositsCount, since depositsCount+1 never overflows; the mutant requires depositsCount>0 and reverts the first deposit, so it fails for some input.
change_summary: Replace the overflow-guard condition with 'require(depositsCount > 0);' so the first deposit reverts and subsequent behavior differs.
